fix_surveys_answer_check.name: fix_surveys_answer_check
fix_surveys_answer_check.value: ("fix_surveys"."answer" IS NULL) = ("fix_surveys"."answered_at" IS NULL) AND ("fix_surveys"."answer" IS NULL OR "fix_surveys"."answer" IN ('fixed', 'not_fixed'))

demand_updates_status_check.name: demand_updates_status_check
demand_updates_status_check.value: ("demand_updates"."action" = 'status') = ("demand_updates"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "demand_updates"."fulfilment_status" IS NOT NULL) AND ("demand_updates"."response_status" IS NULL OR "demand_updates"."response_status" IN ('not_responded', 'responded')) AND ("demand_updates"."fulfilment_status" IS NULL OR "demand_updates"."fulfilment_status" IN ('not_fulfilled', 'partially_fulfilled', 'fulfilled', 'rejected'))

demand_updates_source_check.name: demand_updates_source_check
demand_updates_source_check.value: ("demand_updates"."action" NOT IN ('status', 'note') OR ("demand_updates"."note" IS NOT NULL AND "demand_updates"."source_text" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("demand_updates"."source_url" IS NULL OR "demand_updates"."source_url" ~ '^https?://')

demands_region_check.name: demands_region_check
demands_region_check.value: ("demands"."scope" = 'national' AND "demands"."province_code" IS NULL AND "demands"."regency_code" IS NULL) OR ("demands"."scope" = 'regional' AND "demands"."province_code" IS NOT NULL AND ("demands"."regency_code" IS NULL OR starts_with("demands"."regency_code", "demands"."province_code" || '.')))

demands_published_check.name: demands_published_check
demands_published_check.value: ("demands"."state" = 'draft' OR "demands"."published_at" IS NOT NULL) AND (("demands"."state" = 'closed') = ("demands"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL))

demands_hidden_check.name: demands_hidden_check
demands_hidden_check.value: ("demands"."hidden_at" IS NULL) = ("demands"."hidden_reason" IS NULL) AND ("demands"."hidden_reason" IS NULL OR "demands"."hidden_reason" IN ('standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13', 'komdigi_order', 'data_subject_request')) AND ("demands"."hidden_at" IS NULL OR "demands"."state" = 'draft')

issues_redaction_check.name: issues_redaction_check
issues_redaction_check.value: ("issues"."redacted_at" IS NULL) = ("issues"."redaction_reason" IS NULL) AND ("issues"."redaction_reason" IS NULL OR "issues"."redaction_reason" IN ('standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13'))

issues_takedown_check.name: issues_takedown_check
issues_takedown_check.value: ("issues"."taken_down_at" IS NULL) = ("issues"."takedown_reason" IS NULL) AND ("issues"."takedown_reason" IS NULL OR "issues"."takedown_reason" IN ('standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13', 'komdigi_order', 'data_subject_request')) AND ("issues"."taken_down_at" IS NULL OR "issues"."published_at" IS NULL)

referrals_deadline_check.name: referrals_deadline_check
referrals_deadline_check.value: ("referrals"."kind" = 'escalation' OR "referrals"."deadline_on" IS NOT NULL) AND ("referrals"."deadline_on" IS NULL OR "referrals"."deadline_on" >= "referrals"."sent_on")

resolution_claims_closed_check.name: resolution_claims_closed_check
resolution_claims_closed_check.value: ("resolution_claims"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("resolution_claims"."outcome" IS NULL) AND ("resolution_claims"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("resolution_claims"."basis" IS NULL)

content_complaints_decision_check.name: content_complaints_decision_check
content_complaints_decision_check.value: ("content_complaints"."decision" IS NULL OR "content_complaints"."decision" IN ('keep', 'edit', 'hide', 'remove')) AND ("content_complaints"."appeal_decision" IS NULL OR "content_complaints"."appeal_decision" IN ('keep', 'edit', 'hide', 'remove')) AND ("content_complaints"."decision_reason" IS NULL OR "content_complaints"."decision_reason" IN ('no_violation', 'insufficient_detail', 'standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13')) AND ("content_complaints"."appeal_reason" IS NULL OR "content_complaints"."appeal_reason" IN ('no_violation', 'insufficient_detail', 'standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13'))

content_complaints_decided_check.name: content_complaints_decided_check
content_complaints_decided_check.value: ("content_complaints"."status" IN ('decided', 'appealed', 'appeal_decided')) = ("content_complaints"."decision" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."decision_text" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

content_complaints_appealed_check.name: content_complaints_appealed_check
content_complaints_appealed_check.value: ("content_complaints"."status" IN ('appealed', 'appeal_decided')) = ("content_complaints"."appeal_text" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."appealed_at" IS NOT NULL)

content_complaints_appeal_decided_check.name: content_complaints_appeal_decided_check
content_complaints_appeal_decided_check.value: ("content_complaints"."status" = 'appeal_decided') = ("content_complaints"."appeal_decision" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."appeal_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."appeal_decision_text" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."appeal_decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "content_complaints"."appeal_decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

moderation_decisions_reason_check.name: moderation_decisions_reason_check
moderation_decisions_reason_check.value: ("moderation_decisions"."action" = 'verify' AND "moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IN ('document', 'site_photo', 'second_party', 'news_source', 'reporter_contact') AND "moderation_decisions"."reason_text" IS NULL) OR ("moderation_decisions"."action" = 'reject' AND ("moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IS NULL OR "moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IN ('standard_1', 'standard_2', 'standard_3', 'standard_4', 'standard_5', 'standard_6', 'standard_7', 'standard_8', 'standard_9', 'standard_10', 'standard_11', 'standard_12', 'standard_13', 'out_of_scope')) AND "moderation_decisions"."reason_text" IS NOT NULL) OR ("moderation_decisions"."action" = 'mark_unverifiable' AND ("moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IS NULL OR "moderation_decisions"."reason_code" IN ('no_evidence', 'source_unreachable', 'conflicting_information', 'location_unclear')) AND "moderation_decisions"."reason_text" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_subject_check.name: notifications_subject_check
notifications_subject_check.value: num_nonnulls("notifications"."report_id", "notifications"."issue_id", "notifications"."complaint_id", "notifications"."demand_id", "notifications"."reply_id") = CASE WHEN "notifications"."template" IN ('referral_deadline') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

agency_replies_decision_check.name: agency_replies_decision_check
agency_replies_decision_check.value: ("agency_replies"."status" = 'pending') = ("agency_replies"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("agency_replies"."status" = 'rejected') = ("agency_replies"."reject_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("agency_replies"."status" = 'accepted') = ("agency_replies"."response_id" IS NOT NULL)

reports_other_consent_check.name: reports_other_consent_check
reports_other_consent_check.value: ("reports"."relation" = 'on_behalf') = ("reports"."other_consent" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reports"."other_consent" IS NULL OR "reports"."other_consent" IN ('yes', 'not_asked', 'cannot_ask'))
